parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue of unnecessary joins in the admin changelist query by combining search terms into a single Q object. The change is minimal and focused on the problem area.

issues.description: The patch introduces new files (server.log, test.db, testapp/__init__.py, testapp/admin.py, testapp/migrations/0001_initial.py, testapp/migrations/__init__.py, testapp/models.py, tests/__init__.py) that are not directly related to fixing the issue. These files seem to be test setup files, but their inclusion in the diff is not clear.
